book.name: Aisaiya
book.title: Aisaiya Aisaiya Bin Gibit Wed Brom God

content: Jerusalem garra abumbat adtaim
Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Jerusalem, det taun blanga King Deibid, yu det speshalwan pleis blanga main. Yu garram bigiswan trabul na. Yu oldei abumbat bigismob serramoni ebriyiya.
Bat ai garra jandim nogudbala ting langa yu, en yu garra stil abumbat loda pein en yu garra jidan brabli soribala en yu garra oldei kraikraibat nomo lilbit du.
Ai garra kaman langa yu en fait langa yu brom ebrisaid, jis laik King Deibid bin dum.
En yu garra jingat brom andanith langa dijan graun blanga sambodi blanga kaman en album yu, en nobodi kaan adli irrim yu.
“Bat afta na yu krulbala enami garra ol binij du wulijim det das weya det win oldei blowimbat.
En mi na YAWEI det boswan God garra kaman kwikbala en seibum yu, en det graun garra sheiksheik, en yu garra irrim det thanda garra jingat adbala en det faiya en win garra kaman.
En detlot krulbala pipul hu kaman en faitfaitbat langa yu en meigimbat yu oldei abumbat loda pein, dei garra gowei kwikbala, jis laik det drim weya gowei wen yu gidap brom silip.

En ol detlot pipul brom najalot kantri hu kaman en fait langa det bigwan hil gulum Saiyan, olabat garra jidan hanggriwan en thestiwan. Olabat garra oldei abum drim weya im abum blendibala daga en woda, bat olabat garra gidap brom silip stil hanggriwan en thestiwan.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.
Ola speshalwan mesinja hu dumbat nogudbala ting

Wal aibin tok, “Yumob speshalwan mesinja, yumob nomo lisin langa mi en yumob kipgon dumbat nogudbala ting. Wal yumob kipgon jidan blainwan. En yumob jidan drangginbala, nomeda yumob nomo bin dringgimbat eni wain. Najing.
Dumaji YAWEI det trubala God na bin meigim yumob jidan jis laik yumob silipiwan. Yumob speshalwan mesinja garra lafta abum gudwan ai, bat YAWEI bin gaburrumap yumob ai.
Wal dijan mesij blanga im, im jis laiga leda weya deibin jadimap garram det bushgam. Sambala pipul garra tok, ‘Melabat kaan ridim dijan, dumaji im nomo opinwan.’
En najalot pipul garra tok, ‘Melabat kaan ridim dijan dumaji melabat nomo sabi ridim dislot wed.’

“Wal YAWEI bin tok na, ‘Dislot pipul oldei preisimbat langa mi garram olabat wed, bat olabat nomo rili jinggabat langa mi brabliwei. Dei oldei weship mi garram sambala lowa weya dei meigimapbat olabat ronselp.

Wal blanga tharran na, ai garra dumbat olkain klebawan ting, en ai garra meigimbat olabat brabli hatjamp. Ai garra meigim olabat nomo blanga sabi enijing, nomeda olabat reken olabat sabi ebrijing.’ Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.
“Wal ol yumob pipul garra abum trabul if yumob trai blanga blandim yumob plen brom YAWEI, o if yu reken yu gin dum samting langa dakbala pleis weya nobodi kaan luk langa yu.
Yumob brabli granggibala. Det klei dish im kaan tok langa det men hubin meigim im, ‘Yu nomo bin meigim mi. Yu nomo sabi hau blanga meigim mi.’”
Brabli gudbala ting garra kaman bambai
Wal aibin kipgon tok, “Det kantri langa Lebanan garram bigismob tri, bat im garra jidan jis laiga gudwan fam dregli, en bambai det fam im garra abum bigismob tri igin.
En langa det taim na, detlot pipul hubin jidanbat defwan longtaim garra irrim sambodi ridimbat langa olabat, en detlot pipul hubin oldei jidanbat blainwan garra luk gudwei.
Detlot powan pipul, en detlot pipul hu nomo garram enibodi blanga lukaftumbat olabat, garra jinginatbat brabli hepiwan langa YAWEI det brabli holiwan God blanga ola Isreil pipul.

Bat detlot praudbala pipul hu oldei gibit bekboun langa God, en hu oldei dumbat krulbala ting langa najalot pipul, garra ol binijap mijamet garram detlot pipul hu oldei dalimbat laiyawan wed langa kothaus, en nomo larram najalot pipul blanga abum feyago.

“Wal blanga tharran na, YAWEI hubin album Eibrahem wen imbin abum trabul, bin tok langa Jeikob bigininimob, ol detlot Isreil pipul. Imbin tok, ‘Main pipul olabat, yumob kaan nogudbinji en sheim miselp enimo.
Wen yumob luk ola biginini en ola ebrijing aibin gibit yumob, yumob garra preisim langa mi en shoum rispek langa mi, det brabli holiwan God blanga ola Isreil pipul.

En enibodi hu nomo sabi enijing, garra sabi ebrijing na, en detlot pipul hu oldei grambul en faindim folt langa enibodi, garra bilib en teiknodis wanim aibin titjimbat yumob.’ Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.”
